content: निग्रहः .²1 Keeping in check, restraint, curbing, subjection; as in इन्द्रियानिग्रह <ls>Ms. 6. 92</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 222</ls>; <ls>Bh. 1. 66</ls>; चञ्चलं मनः … तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम् <ls>Bg. 6. 34</ls>; तस्य ता वपुषाक्षिप्ता निग्रहार्थं जजृम्भिरे <ls>Bu. Ch. 4. 6</ls>. .²2 Suppression, obstruction, putting down; तथेन्द्रियाणां दह्यन्ते दोषाः प्राणस्य निग्रहात् <ls>Ms. 6. 71</ls>. .²3 Overtaking, capturing, arresting; त्वन्निग्रहे तु वरगात्रि न मे प्रयत्नः <ls>Mk. 1. 22</ls>; <ls>Śi. 2. 88</ls>. .²4 Confinement, imprisonment. .²5 Defeat, overthrow, vanquishing. .²6 Dispelling, destruction, removing; दिनमुखानि रविर्हिमनिग्रहैर्विमलयन् मलयं नगमत्यजत् <ls>R. 9. 25</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 6</ls>; <ls>Ku. 5. 53</ls>. .²7 Arresting of disease, cure. .²8 Punishment (<ab>opp.</ab> अनुग्रह) निग्राहानुग्रहस्य कर्ता <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; निग्रहोऽप्ययमनुग्रहीकृतः <ls>R. 11. 90</ls>, <ls n="R. 11.">55</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 52</ls>, <ls n="R. 12.">63</ls>. .²9 Rebuke, reprimand, blame. .²10 Aversion, dislike, disgust. .²11 (In Nyāya <ab>phil.</ab>) A flaw in an argument, a fault in a syllogism (by which a disputant is put down in argument); <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Mu. 5. 10</ls>. .²12 A handle. .²13 A limit, boundary. .²14 The Supreme Being. .²15 Transgressing (अतिलङ्घन); निग्रहाद्धर्मशास्त्राणामनुरुद्धपन्नपेतभीः <ls>Mb. 12. 24. 13</ls>.
